name: Digit 5
price_note: sold via deployment contracts / RaaS; no list price
summary: A ground-up redesign of Digit, unveiled 15 September 2026, with a new leg architecture, a 50 lb (22.7 kg) lift and fast charging that Agility says gives more than 20 productive hours a day (a 10:1 run-to-charge ratio, against Digit 4's 2:1). It is built to work closer to people without fixed barriers. Agility's SPAC filing describes a US$300M, 1,000-unit RaaS commitment from a related-party customer, and the company listed on Nasdaq in November 2026.
notable: Designed for cooperatively safe work without fixed guarding
